totals.interpretation: Artifact rubric only. A recorded scope deviation prevents treating this as clean cold-run evidence; no population reliability claim.

findings.summary: No tracker source failure or repair observed. First and final programs have the same hash and pass all private semantic cases; first scenarios pass 7/7, final 9/9.

Separate minimal repro initially lacked an event (receipt 012); initial proposed correction cited evidence rather than its read state (013). Agent added event, retained the requested real claim error (015), and cited value_used (016/017).

Bootstrap receipts are partial reconstructed excerpts, clearly labeled; not every shell wrapper has a separate authored receipt. External command transcript supplies ordering evidence. Complete original broad enumeration output was truncated upstream.

protocolDeviations.description: Initial commands ran from the drive root after a working-directory/permission failure. Get-ChildItem and rg --files enumerated outside the assigned workspace. This violates the task procedural scope even though it was accidental and later disclosed.
protocolDeviations.observedMaterial: Directory listings, file path enumeration, access errors and environment locations. Retained broad rg output has 1,048,609 characters across approximately 13,530 lines. No evaluator/gold/other-trial source content was observed; these commands enumerate names, not file contents. Retained broad output contains no caveat-lang or private evaluator/other-trial path matches. The Caveat strings in line 11 are attempted assigned-workspace paths in the access error.
protocolDeviations.uncertainty: The initial enumeration was truncated; absence of a match in retained text cannot establish what path names were in discarded output. Cannot certify complete context purity or lack of influence. Do not describe this trial as a clean cold run.
protocolDeviations.recovery: Later explicit scoped Set-Location with ErrorAction Stop and authorized escalation succeeded (line 14/item_6), followed by package-only documentation reads.
